they.definition:
obj. The plural of he, she, or it. They is never used
   adjectively, but always as a pronoun proper, and sometimes refers to
   persons without an antecedent expressed.

they had a baby last month.translation: 他们上个月添了一个宝宝
they had a baby last month.word: They had a baby last month

they had to call in a heart specialist.translation: 他们必须请心脏专门医生来
they had to call in a heart specialist.word: They had to call in a heart specialist

they operated on him last night.translation: 他们昨晚给他动过手术
they operated on him last night.word: They operated on him last night

they say.translation: 人们说, 据说, 通常认为

they say the film is an adventure story.translation: 他们说这片子是一个冒险故事
they say the film is an adventure story.word: They say the film is an adventure story

they serve good food in this restaurant.translation: 这家菜馆供应的菜很好
they serve good food in this restaurant.word: They serve good food in this restaurant

they signed off two hours ago.translation: 他们两小时以前就播完了
they signed off two hours ago.word: They signed off two hours ago

they've.translation: abbr. they have 他们曾经

they-all.translation: [网络] 他们大家都；起身；他们都来帮助我了
